# 0. Cell-type taxonomy (input vs output)

The 360 cells are of two kinds, and the distinction is load-bearing:

| **Cell type** | **Components** | **Count** | **Nature** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Static-prior (input) | B, D | 216 (156 B + 60 D) | Stored biology — the priors the engine reads **in**. Fixed values, audited, ratified. |
| Post-test / output | C | 144 | The support-modulation read **out** of a result geometry. NOT a stored prior — defined by role, valued only post-test. |

Why C is output, not input: main and support are derived **from** the produced geometry (answers → engine → geometry → read main + support). Support is therefore strictly downstream of the geometry and cannot also be an input to producing it without circularity. C-as-static-prior inverted that derivation; C-as-post-test-output is the correct layer. (This also explains why 128 of the 144 C-cells sat at 0 in the static framing — a post-test cell has no meaningful stored value; it is *defined, not yet valued*.)

Consequence: B(archetype, f) and C(archetype, f) sit on the same grid but answer different questions — B is the archetype’s *own* resting expression (prior); C is how that archetype, when the geometry reads it as *your* support, modulates *your* f (post-test). Same grid, different layer, different time — not redundant.

# 1. Component → row map

| **Component** | **Rows** | **Members** | **Type** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| B — Cognitive Function Profile | 13 | The 12 cognitive functions + Supervision. | static-prior (input) |
| C — Support Modulation Profile | 12 | The 12 cognitive functions only (no Supervision). | post-test / output |
| D — State-Class Signatures | 5 | D1–D5. | static-prior (input) |

13 + 12 + 5 = 30 rows per archetype × 12 archetypes = 360 long-format rows — of which 216 are static-prior (B + D) and 144 are post-test / output (C). The 360-cell structure is preserved; the two cell-types are distinguished by §0, not by removing rows.

# 2. The twelve cognitive functions (the wheel) + Supervision

The twelve, ordered per the C12 star (order is semantic, not metric): Differentiation, Computation, Coordination, Attention, Realisation, Motion, Modulation, Perception, Recognition, Integration, Interpretation, Abstraction.

Supervision is the thirteenth element, not a wheel function. It is the supervisory mechanism (archetype-as-dynamic-shaping; the push/pull toward the ought, priced at the dACC/BST cost-seat). It appears as a Component-B row only, derived off the angular wheel from the supervisory mechanism — not kernel-placed. It is absent from Component C because C is the post-test support-modulation over the twelve, and the supervisory mechanism does not modulate itself.

# 3. Component definitions and per-cell columns

| **Component** | **Value** | **Per-cell columns** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| B — resting cognitive profile | Score (expression-intensity at default load, 0–100) | Function · Score · Reasoning (3-point) · Source-Anchor Trace (V.1.1 step 6) · Conf. (mech / app) |
| C — support modulation (POST-TEST / output) | Per cell, a *definition*, not a stored scalar: a [Effect] direction (the group-anchor’s modulation tendency — the structural scaffold) typed post-test (magnitude read off the support-weight in the result geometry; active only when the geometry reads this archetype as a support). Cells outside their group’s [Effect] set carry “no channel,” not 0. | Function · [Effect] direction · Reasoning (3-point) · Source-Anchor Trace · Conf. (mech / app) — the post-test magnitude is computed by the bleed system, not stored here |
| D — state-class signature | 0–100 absolute expression-intensity scalar at that state (D1 is the baseline value per archetype, NOT normalised to 1) | State · Score · Reasoning (3-point) · Source-Anchor Trace (V.1.3 step 6) · Conf. (mech / app) · **state_mechanism** (D1–D4; originating mechanism, §4.4) · **strain_response** (D2; enum, §4.4) · **state_relation** (D1–D4; 5→4 edge onset, §4.4) · **failure_mode** (D5 only; enum, §4.1) · **valence_trajectory** (sign per state; default neutral, §4.2) |

# 4. State classes (Component D members)

D1 Coherent baseline · D2 Strained · D3 Entrenched · D4 Acute dysregulation · D5 Fractured/Collapse. Each state stores a 0–100 absolute expression-intensity scalar (semantic locked per Profile Template v2 / Engine Spec §0.05): D1 is the baseline value per archetype, D2–D5 the R-class curve evaluated at each state. The B×D state-shift multiplier (D_state ÷ D1) is the downstream cross-coherence derivative — computed, not stored (per §5). Uniform across all twelve archetypes in **stored format** (every archetype stores five 0–100 scalars identically, including the Relational pair’s neutral-field readiness baseline) — but the *computed* surface-transform this multiplier feeds is **function-differential, not uniform** (per the v1.5 changelog [L2–L4]): the same D_state applies differently across functions according to each function’s network-coupling, which is what produces the D3→D4 rank-inversion. “Uniform” here is a statement about storage format, never about the transform.

## 4.1 D5 failure-mode field (v1.7 — Component-D enrichment)

The D5 label “Fractured/Collapse” is a state-name, not a mechanism; it conflates distinct collapse shapes. Each D5 cell carries a **failure_mode** field — a queryable enum naming the originating mechanism of that group’s collapse (carved at origin, not terminal, per the Ch4.A5-RULE construction rule). The enum has **five abstract modes** realised as **six group-instantiations**:

| failure_mode (enum) | Groups (instantiations) | Mechanism (originating) | Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| rigidity_lock | CEN (Ruler/Judge) | control over-tightens; Arnsten prefrontal-switch → synaptic depletion | holds |
| dissolution_chaos | SN (Outlaw/Trickster) | salience-network destabilisation; boundary fails outward into incoherence | fails (outward) |
| dissolution_fusion | Limbic (Lover/Caregiver) | attachment-system over-bonding; boundary fails inward into the other | fails (inward) |
| dissociation | DMN (Sage/Artist) | cortico-limbic disconnection; prefrontal over-suppression seals interior | over-holds |
| drive_depletion | Motor (Magician/Hero) | BAS effort over-mobilisation → vigour exhaustion | depletes |
| valence_inversion | LC-NE (Innocent/Explorer) | amygdala-LC tonic-shift; LHb anti-reward; appetitive→aversive sign-flip | inverts→depletes |

dissolution_chaos and dissolution_fusion are two **direction-instantiations of one abstract mode** (dissolution); the other four are one-instantiation modes. Stored as the precise instantiation (six values), not the abstract mode (five) — the abstract grouping is recoverable by query, the instantiation is not, so the finer grain is stored (M1/Ch4.A5-RULE: carve at origin, the more specific mechanism).

**mode_relation (the 5→4 convergence edge).** A directional annotation: valence_inversion **recruits** drive_depletion downstream (LHb→RMTg→dopamine-suppression) — valence-collapse can terminate in depletion; depletion does not require valence-inversion. Stored as a relation on the mode-5 (LC-NE) and mode-4 (Motor) cells, NOT by merging them. The engine needs it because both look anhedonic at terminal but dissociate at origin. Representing convergence as a relation (never a merge) is the Ch4.A5-RULE applied to the schema.

## 4.2 Valence-trajectory field (v1.7)

The D-curve carries, for some groups, a **valence sign** across states, not only an intensity magnitude. The **valence_trajectory** field records the sign-progression. Default = neutral (intensity-only). The LC-NE/Seeker group carries approach→defensive: approach-valence early (D1–D2, phasic-LC/BLA-NAc) inverting to defensive/aversive late (D4–D5, tonic-LC/BLA-CeA), the D3→D4 crash being the tonic-shift inversion point. Other groups’ trajectories (Limbic deepen-fusion, CEN rigidify, SN dissolve) are carried in the failure_mode + reasoning; valence_trajectory is populated where the curve carries a genuine sign-flip (currently LC-NE; others default neutral unless a sign-flip is established).

## 4.3 Transform grounding — the four mechanism-axes (v1.7, §7 cross-ref)

The six R-class collapse-laws ground on **four shared mechanism-axes**, each a single control-parameter with poles/instantiations (not six bespoke mechanisms): (i) **cortico-limbic coupling** — DMN over-suppression/seal ↔ Limbic over-flooding/fusion; (ii) **criticality tuning** — CEN over-constrained/rigid ↔ SN under-constrained/fluid; (iii) **effort/drive mobilisation** — Motor (single-pole); (iv) **valuation/incentive** — LC-NE (single-pole). Axes (iii) and (iv) are linked only by the mode-5→4 terminal convergence. This is the transform’s grounding, cross-referenced to Rosetta Ch4.A5-EXT and each HG §7. **Autonomic signals (HRV) are admissible as markers, never as collapse mechanism** (“marker yes, mechanism no”) — the cortico-limbic and attachment mechanisms supersede the prior vagal framing for the DMN and Limbic transforms.

## 4.4 D1–D4 enrichment — state_mechanism + strain_response + state_relation (v1.8 — Component-D enrichment, D1–D4 lift)

*Scope: value-preserving lift, governed by Ch4.A5-RULE exactly as D5/§4.1 was (“it governs the D1–D4 enrichment to come as it governed D5”). The §7 cost-curves already carry per-state **mechanism for D1–D4 across all six groups; this section lifts that existing mechanism into queryable fields. No stored 0–100 scalar changes — D1–D4 values stand; this adds classification/mechanism/relation fields and is the D1–D4 analogue of §4.1. Matrix → v3.3 (field population; values unchanged).*

**(1) state_mechanism field (D1–D4, all cells).** The originating mechanism at that load, lifted from each group’s §7 — carried at origin (the mechanism that *generates* the state), not at terminal surface. The state-trajectory is one mechanism-axis read at four loads: D1 = the axis in balance (healthy expression); D2 = first response to strain; D3 = entrenchment of the D2 response; D4 = acute failure of it.

**(2) strain_response field (D2 cells; the carve-point — the D2 analogue of D5’s failure_mode).** A queryable enum of **six origin-distinct strain-response modes**, one per hardware group. These are carved at originating mechanism (how the class *first answers* strain), per the A5-RULE — they do not collapse into fewer, and the §7 docs already define each by explicit contrast with the others:

| strain_response (enum) | Group (instantiation) | Mechanism (originating) | Direction |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mask | CEN (Ruler/Judge) | control tightens; strain hidden behind maintained structure — under-expresses D2, does not visibly wobble | suppress-inward |
| rise | SN (Outlaw/Trickster) | salience activation increases; strain is fuel — the rebel sharpens | amplify-outward |
| escalate | Motor (Magician/Hero) | BAS approach-drive increases; works harder, doubles down | amplify-outward |
| buffer | LC-NE (Innocent/Explorer) | strain absorbed via denial (holds the bubble) or flight (converts to movement) | absorb/deflect |
| withdraw | DMN (Sage/Artist) | turns further inward; more reflection, does not externalise | suppress-inward |
| cling | Limbic (Lover/Caregiver) | attachment-system hyperactivation; binds tighter to the other — strain increases the bond | bind-toward |

The four-axis grounding (§4.3) holds at D2: mask/withdraw are the suppress-inward instantiations of the two over-constraining poles (CEN-criticality, DMN-cortico-limbic); rise/escalate the amplify-outward instantiations of the complementary drives (SN-criticality, Motor-effort); buffer the valuation-axis absorb; cling the cortico-limbic flood pole. **The direction column is a coarsening recoverable by query; strain_response stores the precise six-mode instantiation (M1/A5-RULE: carve at origin, store the more specific mechanism).**

**(3) state_relation field (D1–D4) — the existing 5→4 edge’s onset, NOT a new edge.** The D1–D4 convergence check (run per A5-RULE) returns **one** relation, and it is the *already-canonical* mode_relation (§4.1), now annotated at its onset state. Per the Seeker §7 curve-shape, the LC-NE valence-inversion **recruits** Motor drive-depletion with onset at the **D3→D4 tonic-shift** (“valence-flip causally upstream of the dopamine-depletion it recruits”; LHb→RMTg→dopamine-suppression). state_relation stores this on the LC-NE (D4) and Motor (D4) cells as the D4-onset of the existing edge — the recruitment begins at acute-dysregulation, not only at collapse. Represented as a relation, never a merge.

**Convergence check — one candidate considered and rejected (logged, not adopted).** The D4 terminals of CEN (“Arnsten switch, structure snaps”) and Motor (“suppressed cost arrives at once, burnout”) share a *terminal* resemblance (sudden depletion-collapse after sustained suppression). This was tested as a candidate second convergence edge and **rejected**: it is a terminal resemblance, not an origin convergence — CEN suppresses limbic input to hold *control* (criticality axis, rigidity_lock); Motor suppresses fear/vulnerability to hold *drive* (effort axis, drive_depletion). The framework already adjudicated this empirically (Engine §ii: “Motor-deplete ≠ CEN-break, shown empirically”; the separation is *why* the five-mode carve beat three). Adopting a CEN↔Motor edge would carve at terminal, violating the A5-RULE, and is the GANE-trap form (a convergence selected by the terminal-similarity tension it would resolve). Logged as considered-not-adopted; not stored.

# 5. Exoskelet long-format row

Every one of the 360 rows carries these data columns (source + confidence + reference as columns, never prose):

| **Column** | **Contents** |
| --- | --- |
| archetype | 1–12 / name. |
| component | B / C / D. |
| member | Function name · Supervision (B only) · state-class (D). |
| value | Score (B) · Δ (C) · 0–100 scalar (D). |
| reasoning | 3-point protocol. |
| source_anchor | The V.1.x step-6 trace — source + reference. Mandatory; a cell without it does not enter. |
| confidence | mech / app (mechanism confidence, application confidence). |

Row key: (archetype, component, member). Per-cell state shifts (Component B → Component D) are computed in the downstream cross-coherence layer — NOT stored as rows.

# 6. Load-bearing invariants

Supervision placement. Component B only; off-wheel; from the supervisory mechanism. Never in Component C; never a kernel point.

Component D uniformity. All twelve carry five D-state values (0–100 absolute); the Relational pair is the neutral-field readiness baseline, derived like the rest. Live coupling is a runtime overlay, not a stored value.

Values are ratified, not engine-final. The engine proposes B/C/D with exploratory globals; the human ratifies; the matrix stores the ratified values and the logged residual. Engine globals are calibrated only against the complete ratified matrix (Principle 9 / methodology #5) — never from a subset.

Per-cell source-anchor mandatory. Source + confidence + reference are data columns on every cell. No trace → the cell does not enter.

Dynamic-matrix, probabilistic. All twelve archetypes default-access all functions; values are expression-intensities at default load, tendencies not determinations. Never static-positional.

Cell-type separation (supersedes the v1.2 “supplied → anchor → C-N/A” invariant). C is not a static modulation of B-anchors, so the B-layer anchor/released status does not gate C. The Stage-1 reclassifications (sibling-carry, forward-Interpretation, Attention-supplied) are B-layer facts: they fix what kind of static prior a B-cell is. C lives on a different layer (post-test output) and is defined for all 144 (archetype, function) channels by the group [Effect] map, independent of any B-cell’s anchor status. The earlier reading — that the 26 supplied B-cells “zeroed” their C-rows — was an artifact of treating C as a static modulation of B; under the cell-type taxonomy (§0) the two layers do not collide. The held-investigation flags (Innocent/Explorer Modulation), now reclassed to confirmed-perturbation (Stage-4), likewise live on the B-layer and do not bear on C.

# 7. Trace-annotation vocabulary (Stage-1 consolidation)

The source_anchor column always carries the mandatory V.1.x step-6 trace (source + reference, §5). Beyond that base trace it may carry one of three optional tags recording a disposition applied during the Stage-1 consolidation cycle. All are value-preserving — they annotate mechanism/disposition, never the stored value.

| trace-flag: | An open disposition carried on the cell — a held or flagged investigation, not yet a settled class. A held-investigation flag resolves to a settled class when its lineage is confirmed (e.g. the Seeker·Modulation held-investigation → confirmed-perturbation at Stage-4). | held-investigation → confirmed-perturbation |
| trace-geom: red seam | Value-preserving two-layer geometry annotation — records the hardware locus (the red seam) beside a D-layer recovery cue, per [GEO-2L]. The stored value is unchanged. | red-seam (D5 recovery cues) |

# 8. The post-test / output layer (Component C)

C is the support-modulation layer, read off the result geometry, not a stored prior (§0). In the matrix each C-cell is *defined by what it is*, not by a static value:

- Cells in their group’s [Effect] set carry the [Effect] direction (the structural scaffold) typed post-test — e.g. “[Effect] +, post-test magnitude.”

- Cells outside the [Effect] set carry “no channel” — there is no support-modulation path for that (archetype, function) pair. (This is the honest reading of the former 0s.)

The post-test magnitude — and the mechanism that activates a channel when the geometry reads its archetype as a support — is **not** specified here. It belongs to the post-engine bleed system (the questions, their point attributions, and the support-read computation), which is deferred to post-matrix per P9: an output-layer read is computed once against the complete instrument, not committed as a prior beforehand. Until then, the C-cells stand as typed definitions, carrying their [Effect] scaffold and the post-test marker.

# Component Semantics (ratified captions — v1.9 amendment)

**B — Allocation.** How the supervisor splits its energy. The expression-weighting across the thirteen functions: what the configuration does, as distribution.

**C — Interface.** What the hardware permits and prefers. The substrate-side constraint through which supervision is conducted — and the supervisor remains a workable function under C: the C-direction clauses record supervisory modulation as conducted through hardware permission and preference. Permission-frame and operation-frame are two sides of one layer, not rivals. (Methodological warrant: C-as-constraint, Ledger entry 8, Juarrero — constraint, not force; the operation-side stands alongside, not beneath.)

**D — Price.** The cost curve of the transformations that result, forced or willing. Willing transformations are the supervisory push toward the ought; forced transformations include expression pushed past hardware preference under load. Both are priced here.

**Non-exclusion clause.** These captions state what each component captures. They do not assign exclusive ownership of any behaviour to one component, and no existing clause language elsewhere in canon is re-read under them. Where a caption and a clause appear to conflict, the conflict is surfaced per the fix-at-highest-layer rule, not resolved by the caption silently winning.

**State-indexing corollary.** C’s static priors are default-load facts. Load-state excursions of a function past hardware preference — amplification into dispreferred extremes, or damping into dispreferred silence — are D-layer content, priced as forced transformation. A closed static C cell and a live load-excursion are the same channel read at two state-indices, stored in the components that respectively hold them. (Applied and clause-verified: C-Layer Closure — Exception Resolutions v1.0.)

**Register naming.** The register-and-translation discipline the consumption surfaces run on is named Transpersonal Topology Translation (T³): values across all three components are non-clinical, registered relative narrative-strengths; the report translates relative standings into story and never presents a value as a measurement of the person. The framework’s clinical-probabilistic voice governs how canon is written; T³ governs what the numbers claim. No conflict: the instrument writes clinically about values that are not clinical.

extensions.name: The Emperor
extensions.gift: Sovereign structure fused with the audit: a realm that not only stands but stands JUST — every rule weighed before it binds; authority people can appeal to.
extensions.curse: Anarchy or an unappealable wrong inside the own system → the audit turns inward and merciless; governs by verdict, forgets to govern by care.
extensions.levensles: My judgement holds everything up — but a system that only tells you what is wrong never tells you what it exists for. The rule I have upheld the longest is written nowhere: people are more than their offence.

extensions.name: The Sovereign
extensions.gift: Plato's ideal through the pattern-reader: rule steered by comprehension of the deep structure; policy that is right decades before it is popular.
extensions.curse: Irrationality of the governed → the tower seals; systems intellectually flawless and emotionally uninhabited; wisdom hardens into dogma that no longer listens.
extensions.levensles: I see the pattern before the rest, and that is a lonely lead. But wisdom that does not listen is dogma. The masses who do not understand me are not stupid — they live in a reality my pattern has not yet taken in. Leading is translating — not just knowing.

extensions.name: The Designer
extensions.gift: The realm as a designed thing: leadership that shapes not just order but MEANING — institutions with an aesthetic, structures people want to belong to.
extensions.curse: Ugliness or compromise forced on the design → contempt for the inhabitants; the realm becomes a gallery where living is a violation of the concept.
extensions.levensles: Everything I arrange has to be right and beautiful as well — my house, my schedule, my life. But a life that is not allowed to get dirty is a scale model. The mess of relationships is not a breach of my design; it is what the design existed for.

extensions.name: The Entrepreneur
extensions.gift: Structure meets the frontier: forges unmapped territory into working, profitable systems; the first to build where others still wander.
extensions.curse: Market-failure or a closed frontier → ambition curdles to greed; people become raw material for the next expansion; motion mistaken for direction.
extensions.levensles: I start more easily than I finish; every new plan feels like profit. But building in order to move is not direction. The most valuable thing I own is the one thing I finished rather than abandoned.

extensions.name: The Founder
extensions.gift: Founding power fed by trust: builds institutions on the belief that people are worth building for; the charter that outlives its author because it was written in good faith.
extensions.curse: Betrayal of the founding trust → the crash is total; either naïve doubling-down on a broken charter or a bitter founder who now audits every handshake.
extensions.levensles: I built on trust and I broke on it — yet the new foundation I poured is made of trust again. Distrust finances its own enemy. Trust is not naivety; it is my most valuable material.

extensions.name: The Reformer
extensions.gift: Rebellion integrated into the hierarchy: breaks the corrupt part of the own system from within and replaces it standing; leads by natural authority, not inherited rank.
extensions.curse: Bureaucracy or internal betrayal → own rule-breaking stops feeling like reform and starts feeling like treason; rigid defence of the 'new order' that was born to stay open.
extensions.levensles: I tear apart what is crooked and build something fairer — until my better version needed its first lie and I had to choose between staying a reformer or becoming a ruler. An improvement that is not allowed to be revised is the old system with my name on it.

extensions.name: The Puppeteer
extensions.gift: Rule through the hidden string: reads every player's tell, steers the court by wit and timing; power that never needs to raise its voice because it moved first.
extensions.curse: Being out-played or unmasked → control tightens to manipulation; everyone becomes a puppet, and a ruler of puppets reigns over an empty theatre.
extensions.levensles: I can steer a room without anyone noticing. But whoever has only puppets around them no longer hears a real voice. The biggest move I ever made was showing the strings — and watching who stayed.

extensions.name: The Commander
extensions.gift: Order through the spearpoint: commands from the front, wins territory by will and discipline; the realm grows because its ruler bleeds first.
extensions.curse: Weakness or a lost campaign → expansion becomes identity; crushes autonomy, reads every border as an insult; cannot stop because stopping feels like dying.
extensions.levensles: Winning I can do; staying I had to learn. Growth without limits is disease. What is mine — a family, a business, a body — is not held by conquering, but by being there when there is nothing to win.

extensions.name: The Overlord
extensions.gift: Dominion through leverage: does not storm the wall but owns the gate; reshapes markets, laws and loyalties until the world arrives at the intended order by itself.
extensions.curse: The immovable — a will that cannot be bought or bent → grandiosity; the overlord who mistakes control of the board for control of the players' souls.
extensions.levensles: You can win everything without a single battle: you move the doors and the world walks your way by itself. But the one person I could not move taught me more than all the gates together. Power that steers everything no longer knows what would come to it of its own accord.

extensions.name: The Advocate
extensions.gift: Power as provision made systemic: builds the haven at scale — the ruler whose realm is a shelter, whose budget is an act of care.
extensions.curse: Dependency or sacrifice demanded → smothering; provides so completely that no one is allowed to stand; control exercised through what is given.
extensions.levensles: Everything I love I give a voice, a roof, a chance — and for a long time I thought that was love. But whoever blooms in my light must also be able to bloom outside my shadow. The most beautiful thing I ever protected is the only thing I dared to let go.

extensions.name: The Patron
extensions.gift: Rule warmed by resonance: the patron whose power opens doors for what he loves — art, people, promise; authority that makes others flourish in its light.
extensions.curse: Ingratitude or distance from the favoured → patronage turns to ownership; the beloved protégé becomes a possession, warmth becomes a debt to be repaid.
extensions.levensles: I provide everything for those who depend on me — that is not noble, it is how I am built. But the hand that always gives only teaches the other to receive. The safest thing I ever built was something that no longer needed me.

extensions.name: The Soulmate
extensions.gift: The ultimate fusion grounded in care: not only feels the other completely but BUILDS around them; a bond that is both fire and shelter.
extensions.curse: Perceived distance → clings by caretaking; makes itself indispensable to make itself unleaveable; love administered as service until the self is the missing person.
extensions.levensles: The person I am looking for is not the one who completes me. It is the one who can sit beside me in the imperfect — without filling it. Because caring for the one I love is my language; but whoever makes themselves indispensable is never simply chosen again.

extensions.name: The Companion
extensions.gift: Intimacy bound to order: builds the shared life like a realm — loyal, stable, provisioned; love as a fort with the door on the inside.
extensions.curse: Instability of the frame → terror; when the rules of the relationship wobble, becomes emotionally rigid; defends the fort so hard the beloved starts living outside it.
extensions.levensles: The skeleton I build around love protects it — but it also keeps the chemistry out. The strongest relationship is not the safest. It is the relationship that dares to leave the fort with the door open, and comes back because it wants to, not because the walls say so.

extensions.name: The Betrothed
extensions.gift: Love that gives its word: fidelity as a chosen verdict, the promise weighed before it is spoken and kept after everyone stopped watching.
extensions.curse: Doubt about the other's vow → love turns into evidence-gathering; audits affection, keeps score; the betrothed becomes the accused.
extensions.levensles: My fidelity is not a feeling — it is an act I repeat every day. But a vow is not a contract you go and collect on from the other. The day I stopped gathering evidence and simply kept my own word, the other's fidelity came to light by itself.

extensions.name: The Wingman
extensions.gift: Love's ally with perfect timing: reads what two people cannot say to each other and builds the bridge with a joke; connection engineered through lightness.
extensions.curse: Always the bridge, never the destination → hides the own longing behind the assist; the wingman who lands everyone home and walks back alone, laughing.
extensions.levensles: I see exactly what two people feel for each other before they dare to themselves — but whoever is always the bridge forgets that they have a shore of their own. Helping became my way of hiding. The question I never asked was the only one that was mine.

extensions.name: The Libertine
extensions.gift: Love unshackled: breaks the heavy social scripts around desire; brings uncomplicated joy where duty had bricked the windows shut; pleasure as honest rebellion.
extensions.curse: Confinement sensed → flees into frivolity; the libertine who mistakes every depth for a cage and every cage for a reason to run; freedom that starves.
extensions.levensles: The playfulness with which I break the heaviness is real — but so is the depth I dodge with it. I have broken every rule around love except the only one that counts: staying when it gets light. Someone who stays when it gets dark, you can find anywhere. Someone who stays by daylight — that is the party.

extensions.name: The Poet
extensions.gift: Raw vulnerability translated with precision: emotion passed through understanding into words that make strangers feel known; the line that names what everyone carried.
extensions.curse: Loss of inspiration → melancholy studied instead of lived; dissects the own heart for material until the feeling dies on the table.
extensions.levensles: Not every feeling needs to be understood. Some things may exist without a witness — and it is precisely those quiet moments that feed my work more than the crisis ever did. The most beautiful thing I ever made came about in a year in which I did nothing but live.

extensions.name: The Muse
extensions.gift: Love that ignites making: the presence that turns another's talent incandescent; inspires not by demanding art but by being worth making it for.
extensions.curse: The maker's gaze fading → identity collapse; exists only as reflected in the work of others; the muse who was never asked what she herself would create.
extensions.levensles: I make others bigger — that is a gift until you disappear into it. Whoever exists only in what someone else makes is never finished themselves. The most beautiful ode I ever received was the day someone asked: and what do you make yourself?

extensions.name: The Votary
extensions.gift: Devotion in its purest key: loves one thing wholly and without irony — a person, a craft, a faith; constancy that makes the loved thing MORE true.
extensions.curse: The devoted-to proves unworthy → the world's colour drains; either denial that polishes the idol or a collapse of everything that was built on it.
extensions.levensles: My devotion is not blindness — it is the bravest thing I am. But you can be faithful to someone and to the truth at the same time. The altar I finally built is smaller and more honest, and a candle is still burning on it.

extensions.name: The Moth
extensions.gift: Love as pilgrimage: crosses any distance toward what sets it alight — a person, a place, a transcendence; passion with a compass.
extensions.curse: The flame reached → circles, burns, cannot land or leave; mistakes the intensity of approach for the substance of arrival; wings traded for one bright night.
extensions.levensles: I have always flown towards the light — the brighter it was, the surer I was that it had to be love. That same flame taught me: intensity is a direction, not a destination. The love I landed in was not a fire. It was a lamp that stayed on.

extensions.name: The Romantic
extensions.gift: Love with great intensity and devotion: pursues the bond, fights for it, shows up — the romance that is also a discipline.
extensions.curse: Mistakes intensity for truth → manufactures storms to feel the love prove itself; cannot sit in the quiet where the real thing lives.
extensions.levensles: The intensity with which I love is no proof that it is real. Sometimes the real space lies in the quietest moment, not the fiercest night. I have fought for love in every way there is; the longest lesson was that staying put is one of them too.

extensions.name: The Spellbinder
extensions.gift: Enchantment in love: reads the hidden levers of longing and plays them like an instrument; makes the beloved's world larger, stranger, more alive.
extensions.curse: Magnetism failing → insecurity turns the charm to steering; seduction becomes management of the other's feeling; the spell that, discovered, poisons everything it built.
extensions.levensles: I can make someone feel what I want — that is the gift and the trap. Charm that steers is manipulation, however warm it sounds. The truest enchantment I ever experienced was the day I did nothing, directed nothing — and someone stayed anyway.

extensions.name: The Anarchist
extensions.gift: The absolute disruptor with perfect aim: freedom-drive plus salience-sight; breaks exactly the load-bearing lie and leaves the rest standing.
extensions.curse: System-corruption everywhere → war-mode as home; the rage generalises; destroys everything standing, including the morning that needed a builder.
extensions.levensles: I break what isn't right — with aim, one lie out, the rest left standing. But the morning after needs someone who builds. If that isn't me, it was destruction. If it is, it was a birth.

extensions.name: The Usurper
extensions.gift: Rebellion that seizes the centre: does not petition the corrupt crown but takes it; the usurper whose coup replaces rot with something that actually governs.
extensions.curse: The taken throne → becomes what it overthrew; guards the new crown with the old crown's methods; the revolution that ended the day it won.
extensions.levensles: Asking didn't work, so I took over — and that was right. The real test starts after: do I do it differently, or do I become what I deposed? The uprising has only succeeded if what I build allows an uprising against it.

extensions.name: The Contrarian
extensions.gift: Principled opposition: the built-in counterweight; blocks the consensus precisely where it papers over a wrong; disagreement as a public service.
extensions.curse: Agreement anywhere → suspicion; contradicts by reflex; the contrarian whose 'no' stopped carrying information because it never once said yes.
extensions.levensles: My 'no' has prevented disasters nobody saw. But a no that can never say yes carries no information any more — it's a tic. The hardest part was agreeing with something that ran counter to integrity but meant well.

extensions.name: The Liberator
extensions.gift: Rebellion driven purely by empathy: fights solely to free the oppressed and marginalised; force that exists entirely for someone else's unlocked door.
extensions.curse: Compassion-fatigue → carries the world's pain until burnout; and the liberator's own chains — the ones no crowd cheers for — rust on unbroken.
extensions.levensles: I break free what is trapped — but who breaks my chains? The liberator without self-mastery ends up freeing no one. My own chain was the last — and the heaviest.

extensions.name: The Instigator
extensions.gift: The spark in the crowd: turns private grievance into shared fire; the instigator whose passion makes the timid brave and the scattered one.
extensions.curse: A crowd that cools → provokes to keep the heat; ignites conflicts for the feeling of the flame; the arsonist who misses the fire more than the cause.
extensions.levensles: I can drop a spark into a thousand hearts at once — but fire makes no distinction between warmth and a blaze. The mature form of kindling: first ask what needs warming, and only then the match.

extensions.name: The Iconoclast
extensions.gift: Rebellion applied to dogma: dismantles false idols, dead religions, societal illusions with surgical argument; the hammer that is also a proof.
extensions.curse: Intellectual laziness everywhere → extreme cynicism; isolates; smashes past the false idols into the load-bearing beliefs people actually live in.
extensions.levensles: Every false belief I tear down probably deserves it. But the emptiness I leave behind is not my gift. The real act isn't pulling down the statue — it's giving the plinth something worthier to carry.

extensions.name: The Punk
extensions.gift: Rebellion as raw expression: three chords and the truth; the scene, the zine, the noise that gives the unheard a sound and the polished lie a problem.
extensions.curse: Mainstream absorption → rage at the machine that now sells the rage; authenticity policed until the scene eats itself; loudness mistaken for honesty.
extensions.levensles: I made noise because silence was complicit — and it gave the voiceless a voice. But authenticity isn't a volume knob. The most honest thing I ever said was quieter than everything before it; it finally spoke to the one who needed it most, myself.

extensions.name: The Renegade
extensions.gift: Rebellion in motion: lives beyond the systems entirely; the renegade whose existence outside the walls proves the walls optional; freedom demonstrated, not argued.
extensions.curse: Exile as identity → belongs nowhere on principle; the outside becomes its own cage; free from everything, for nothing.
extensions.levensles: I live outside the lines and prove they're optional. But outlaw freedom also means: free of everyone. The border I finally crossed was the way back — not to fit in, but to show that freedom can live inside too.

extensions.name: The Idealist
extensions.gift: Rebellion with clean hands: refuses the corrupt order out of genuine faith in a better one; the idealist whose incorruptibility shames the cynics into motion.
extensions.curse: The ideal compromised by allies → purism; splits every movement at ninety percent agreement; the perfect wielded as a weapon against the good.
extensions.levensles: I refuse to take part in what isn't right — my clean hands are my argument. But I've watched communities break apart over my thirty per cent of being right. Getting somewhere together is worth more than being right alone.

extensions.name: The Revolutionary
extensions.gift: Disruption amplified by leverage: does not just storm the palace but rewires it; the revolution planned like a paradigm-shift — timing, symbols, structures ready for the morning after.
extensions.curse: Allies' compromise → high treason; the engineered uprising becomes the engineer's possession; purges the revolution to protect the design of it.
extensions.levensles: I am revolt in its rawest form: what I want to break loose cannot be stopped. That was never the problem — the problem is that nothing stopped me. Anyone who thinks they're unstoppable has to set one real limit in the end: otherwise the revolt only stops when there's nothing left.

extensions.name: The Ronin
extensions.gift: Disciplined force without a master: executes on pure conviction; the ronin whose code survived the death of every institution that once housed it.
extensions.curse: Moral betrayal → unmoored; and the standing risk: reads everyone who fails the code as an enemy, when some are just fighting the same fight with less strength.
extensions.levensles: I defied every authority that fell short of my code, but real governance is never spotless. Whoever will only serve the flawless stays masterless forever — and calls it principle. Since then my strength serves two things: the code, and the gentleness that keeps it liveable.

extensions.name: The Developer
extensions.gift: Insight that ships: turns comprehension into working things — theories into tools, patterns into products; the developer whose understanding compiles.
extensions.curse: The elegant refactor without end → building postponed for understanding; or understanding skipped for building; the system rewritten forever, released never.
extensions.levensles: I only understand something once I can build it, and I only build well once I understand it — I shuttled between the two for years. An insight that never ships is a thought. And thoughts get nobody through the winter.

extensions.name: The Analyst
extensions.gift: Philosophy applied to external order: structures raw theory into clear, irrefutable systems; the objective adviser whose analysis becomes the operating manual.
extensions.curse: Ambiguity → analysis-paralysis; no decision survives the next variable; and the system that leaves no room for the irrational governs no actual humans.
extensions.levensles: My systems add up — but people aren't watertight. The sharpest analysis fails if it leaves no room for the irrational. Since then every model of mine has one fixed column: the margin of error called 'human'. That one is sacred.

extensions.name: The Skeptic
extensions.gift: Disciplined doubt: tests every claim against evidence before it may live in the house; the skeptic whose 'prove it' keeps the whole community honest.
extensions.curse: Doubt without a floor → corrodes everything including trust, love, and the own senses; the skeptic who demanded proof of the sunrise and missed it.
extensions.levensles: My doubt has kept out more nonsense than any wall — and where proof exists, the method never fails. But there is a higher order that breaks under testing: trust does not survive a controlled experiment. The sharpest line I ever drew was around my own method.

extensions.name: The Mentor
extensions.gift: Wisdom that carries: guides students and loved ones with vast intelligence used never to dominate; the mentor whose greatest works walk around on their own legs.
extensions.curse: Failure of the student → carried as own failure; and the quiet dependency: needing the pupil's growth as oxygen; wisdom given with an invisible string.
extensions.levensles: Someone else's growth became my oxygen — I only saw that when they no longer needed me. A mentor has succeeded the moment they are superfluous. That's not a loss; that's my diploma.

extensions.name: The Guru
extensions.gift: Teaching through devotion: wisdom transmitted inside a bond so warm the lesson is inseparable from the love; students who learned the material and became better people.
extensions.curse: The devotion inflating → the pedestal; followers instead of students; the guru who started explaining truth and ended performing certainty for an audience that stopped questioning.
extensions.levensles: Everything I pass on is sheltered in truth — I lived it before I learned it. But that same wisdom is also my disguise: as long as I am the lesson, no one sees the wound it comes from. The most valuable lesson anyone ever got came on the day I passed on nothing — only showed where it hurt.

extensions.name: The Hermit
extensions.gift: Conscious radical seclusion: decouples from the collective noise to hear the actual signal; returns from silence with what no meeting would ever have produced.
extensions.curse: Forced interaction → extreme energy-leak; sacred solitude flips to misanthropy; the door barred so long the knock stops coming — and is missed.
extensions.levensles: Some find more truth in silence than a life full of company would ever have brought. It is a high price — and I pay it knowingly. Silence is not leaving the world — it is stripping away the noise so I can hear the connections themselves again. Because what I rediscover there is always about us.

extensions.name: The Theorist
extensions.gift: Play at the level of ideas: builds and breaks conceptual frames for sport; the theorist whose thought-experiments reveal which certainties were furniture all along.
extensions.curse: Theory as evasion → everything reframed, nothing concluded; the elegant model preferred over the inconvenient measurement; games with frames while the house burns.
extensions.levensles: I can both build and break any frame of thought — that game has demolished false certainties people were living in. But theory can also be a way never to choose. Every theory of mine now has to survive one question first: what changes tomorrow because of it — and for whom?

extensions.name: The Enlightened
extensions.gift: The peak of internal reflection: steps outside the self, free of bias; clarity so complete it has stopped needing to win arguments; presence that quiets rooms.
extensions.curse: Material confinement → dissociation; the enlightenment that floats free of the dishes, the traffic, the conversation without direction — and thereby of life.
extensions.levensles: The truth beyond all illusions exists — but it isn't beyond life. It's in it: in the dishes, the traffic jam, the conversation without direction. I moved downstairs. The truth had lived there all along.

extensions.name: The Scholar
extensions.gift: Comprehension in motion: one long search for truth, fed by every new ground entered — borders, fields, disciplines crossed and understood. Depth that travelled for its breadth; a knowing kept alive by never letting the search close.
extensions.curse: The archive as fortress → collects understanding as others collect territory; the footnote perfect, the application forever pending; learned about everything, changed by nothing.
extensions.levensles: I have been searching all my life — every find opens three new questions, and that's how it should be. But searching forever can also be a way of never having to take a stand. One day I acted on what I knew so far — unfinished, provisional, enough. The searching went on; my life just stopped waiting for it.

extensions.name: The Detective
extensions.gift: Truth-finding with directed action: will not rest until hidden patterns and invisible motives surface; comprehension that gets up from the desk and knocks on doors.
extensions.curse: Unresolved anomalies → obsessive checking, paranoid voyeurism; the case that cannot close closes the detective instead.
extensions.levensles: I don't stop until I have the answer — mostly that's a strength. But some questions have no answer, and daring to say 'I don't know' has solved more than my stubbornness ever did. An open file is allowed to exist. So am I.

extensions.name: The Freemason
extensions.gift: Wisdom operationalised in silence: builds the structures, rites and standards that shape the world without signing them; influence exercised as architecture, not announcement.
extensions.curse: Secrecy as a taste → the hidden hand starts preferring the hiding; knowledge hoarded as rank; the lodge that began as a school and calcified into a door-policy.
extensions.levensles: The deepest influence bears no name — you build it in and the world calls it self-evident. But knowledge that lives only behind doors becomes a door itself. My worthiest moment: simply explaining something secret to someone who needed it and wasn't a member of anything.

extensions.name: The Saint
extensions.gift: Embodied hope in motion: carries fundamental trust into cynical places and leaves them lighter; the absolute light that travels.
extensions.curse: Accusation of sin → violent inner reaction; the sainthood defended harder than the goodness lived; purity as a fortress against being seen whole.
extensions.levensles: My trust is not naivety — it is the bravest thing I am. The world does not have to earn it first. But being good is not a possession I have to defend; it is a direction I want to walk, even with dirty feet.

extensions.name: The Shepherd
extensions.gift: Hope anchored in tradition: keeps the values, the rituals, the field where the flock is safe; continuity as a form of love.
extensions.curse: Unpredictability → terror beneath the calm; guards the pasture so rigidly the grass dies; keeping mistaken for holding still.
extensions.levensles: From the outside I am the softest of the flock. But shepherding is not innocence: anyone who protects the defenceless must be able to do what the wolf can. I carry teeth under the wool — and that they are almost never needed is exactly why they are there.

extensions.name: The Traditionalist
extensions.gift: Tradition with a standard: keeps not everything old but everything TRUE in the old; the customs curated, the values audited, the heritage that deserves its keeping.
extensions.curse: The new arriving → judges before understanding; the standard fossilises; defends the letter of a tradition whose spirit already left the building.
extensions.levensles: Sometimes self-preservation disguises itself as loyalty. The tradition I did the most honour to was the tradition I dared to revise — because its spirit was larger than its letter.

extensions.name: The Free Spirit
extensions.gift: Purity plus play: refuses the heaviness of rules without malice; the boundary crossed with a laugh that shows everyone the fence was imaginary.
extensions.curse: Pragmatic confinement → violent stress when the bubble is punctured; flees into whimsy; freedom performed harder the less it is felt.
extensions.levensles: The bubble I live in is not a weakness — it is my laboratory. Play is my serious business. The deepest game I ever played was to keep playing after it turned out the world would not play along.

extensions.name: The Torchbearer
extensions.gift: The torch in dark places: brings uncompromised hope into broken systems; the one who walks into the protest, the ward, the ruin, still believing — and the belief is contagious.
extensions.curse: Darkness that will not lift → the torch guttered; either burns out from carrying light where none returns, or denies the dark so hard the testimony stops being honest.
extensions.levensles: I carry light to places where it has gone out — and that only works if I truly look the dark in the eye. Hope that denies the dark is a lantern with the shutters closed. The torch burns longest in the hand that knows why it carries it.

extensions.name: The Disciple
extensions.gift: Pure hope wed to pattern-sight: designs and holds the vision of the perfect world or theory; faith with an architecture.
extensions.curse: Broken ideals → extreme sensitivity to the world's failure to match the flawless design; grief for a utopia mistaken for a promise.
extensions.levensles: The ideal I see is beautiful — and it does not exist. That is not worth grieving over. This world, messy, ugly and infinitely richer, has taught me the most on its most imperfect days.

extensions.name: The Utopian
extensions.gift: The utopia made visible: paints, writes, builds the better world so vividly that others start walking toward it; hope with a picture attached.
extensions.curse: Reality refusing the design → despair or denial; the utopian who loves the painting more than the people it was painted for.
extensions.levensles: I draw worlds that do not exist yet — that is my purpose. But a utopia is a direction, not an address. The day I let go of my perfect world as a demand and offered it as an invitation, it started to look like something you could live in.

extensions.name: The Pioneer
extensions.gift: Optimism with hands and boots: believes the unknown holds something good AND goes first to prove it; the settlement that exists because someone hopeful was also relentless.
extensions.curse: Loss of momentum → burnout; the vision-fed stress-tolerance collapses at standstill; fears the pause more than the wilderness.
extensions.levensles: I always pull the cart forward as if the unknown is better — and usually that is true. But the courage to stand still when it is dark, without moving, without fleeing: that is the hardest mile I have ever travelled.

extensions.name: The Illuminator
extensions.gift: Hope that transforms on contact: enters a stuck situation and things begin to move — not by force but by the sheer chemistry of believing change is possible.
extensions.curse: The reaction failing to start → doubts the own goodness rather than the conditions; keeps throwing light into inert rooms until the source runs dry.
extensions.levensles: I light hope the way others light candles — my trust lowers the threshold everywhere. But what I set in motion can run the wrong way without me, too. The ripest form of my fire: to light it, and stay to see what it warms.

extensions.name: The Samaritan
extensions.gift: Paradise aimed at the other: unconditional, joyful help for the stranger; forgiveness and provision given without a ledger.
extensions.curse: Cynical reality intruding → flight into denial; helps in order not to feel the dark; goodness as an anaesthetic against the world's actual weight.
extensions.levensles: The forgiveness I offer is real. But so is the right to bear the darkness as well. The price of always shining is the numbing of my own darkness. Even the merciful may lie by the side of the road for once.

extensions.name: The Sweetheart
extensions.gift: Disarming warmth: the presence that makes rooms kinder; loved easily and loving easily; innocence that melts armour nobody knew they wore.
extensions.curse: First betrayal → the sweetness curdles or performs; keeps being adorable to stay safe; the darling everyone adores and no one has actually met.
extensions.levensles: I am easily cherished, and for a long time that was enough. But being thought sweet is not being understood — it is a hiding place with applause. The first person who saw my ugly side and stayed was the first person with whom I truly existed.

extensions.name: The Fool
extensions.gift: Truth as a way of moving: the Fool does not say the unsayable — he walks it. Every entrance, gesture and departure unfiltered; a being so free it cannot be placed, bought, or prepared for. Where he walks, pretence has to reorganise around him.
extensions.curse: The walk absorbed as entertainment — the order applauds and nothing moves → the gait becomes the mask; the free step performed long after it stopped being free; the fool who walked everywhere except inward — the one road that was eating him.
extensions.levensles: I walk what no one dares, that is my freedom and my function — my whole being says what others leave unspoken. But whoever walks their freedom for an audience ends up walking in circles. The clearest step I ever took was inward.

extensions.name: The Gatecrasher
extensions.gift: Sees every structure as a built thing: the frames around power are constructions, and he can read the joinery. Where others see walls he sees assembly — the frame around the throne was never load-bearing, and now everyone has seen it.
extensions.curse: no order left worth exposing → nothing can contain him; belonging reads as capture; the one who saw through every structure can no longer be held by any, including the ones that hold a life together.
extensions.levensles: I see through every frame — status, protocol, closed doors: scenery. But whoever walks through everything has nothing to hold on to anywhere. Not every frame is a cage; some hold a life together. Those I learned to leave standing.

extensions.name: The Devil's Advocate
extensions.gift: Truth through opposition: argues the indefensible so brilliantly that the room finally examines what it believed; the devil's advocate as the immune system of judgement.
extensions.curse: The role consuming the person → contrarian in the marrow; wins every argument and holds no position; a mind that can defend anything and stand for nothing.
extensions.levensles: I can defend any side — a judgement that has never been tested is a habit. But whoever can argue for anything has to know especially well where they themselves stand. My hardest sentence was the first one with 'I think' — no quotation marks, no emergency exit.

extensions.name: The Seducer
extensions.gift: Desire disarmed by play: seduction that is honest about being a game and generous in the playing; awakens people to their own magnetism.
extensions.curse: The game preferred over the prize → collects beginnings; when someone stays, the seducer flees the ending of the chase; charm as a moat around the heart.
extensions.levensles: I made the game into an art — honest about the game, generous in the playing. But every game has a moment where it's allowed to become real, and that is where I always left. The finest conquest was staying put when the game was over.

extensions.name: The Chameleon
extensions.gift: Adaptive care through mimicry: becomes what each person needs — the joker for the grieving, the quiet one for the overwhelmed; camouflage in service of comfort.
extensions.curse: Adapting as default → the own colour forgotten; reads the room so automatically that no room ever reads them; helpful in every shape, known in none.
extensions.levensles: I become what someone needs — care and camouflage at once. But whoever always changes colour to match is never seen. The day I first clashed with the room, I recognised myself.

extensions.name: The Riddler
extensions.gift: Disruption through the riddle: wraps the deepest observations in puzzles that make people THINK their way to the truth; the answer earned lands deeper than the answer given.
extensions.curse: Clarity refused on principle → obscurity as superiority; riddles with no answer, asked to stay untouchable; the riddler nobody solves because nothing was hidden.
extensions.levensles: I wrap truth so that you have to find it yourself — found lands deeper than given. But when someone is drowning, you don't throw a puzzle. The wisest sentence I ever spoke was the simplest, at the only moment simplicity counted.

extensions.name: The Impressionist
extensions.gift: Truth through imitation: catches a person, a type, an era in one gesture; the impression so precise it functions as criticism, portrait and gift at once.
extensions.curse: Only ever the mirror → the imitator's own face unused; celebrated for a hundred voices, silent in the one that is theirs.
extensions.levensles: I can become anyone — one gesture and you recognise the whole person. But playing a hundred voices perfectly is also a way never to test your own. The scariest thing I ever did: mirror myself, with no imitation to stand behind.

extensions.name: The Free-runner
extensions.gift: The world reread asroutes: sees passage where others see walls — over, under, through; obstacles converted to invitations at full speed; improvisation as a physical philosophy.
extensions.curse: Stillness → unbearable; flows around every obstacle including the ones that deserved confronting; a life of perfect evasions and no landings.
extensions.levensles: I see passages where others see walls — everything is a route. But some obstacles aren't meant to be dodged; some walls ask you to stand up to them. The hardest move I know is landing — and staying where I came down.

extensions.name: The Joyrider
extensions.gift: Joy taken without permission: borrows the world for the fun of it; the joyride that harms no one and reminds everyone the rules were never the point of being alive.
extensions.curse: The thrill needing escalation → recklessness; joy that must be stolen to count; the joyrider who cannot enjoy what is freely given, including love.
extensions.levensles: I always borrowed joy without asking — the world is too beautiful to wait for permission. Until I could only enjoy what was stolen. The wildest ride was the tamest: simply accepting something beautiful — and it still flew.

extensions.name: The Shapeshifter
extensions.gift: Constant change of form, identity, perspective as an instrument: plays with the fabric of perception deliberately; shows others their fixed self was always a costume choice.
extensions.curse: No fixed form → can become ruthlessly manipulative or fall into identity-void; the shapeshifter gravity finally catches: every form was real, and none was home.
extensions.levensles: For me form is not a house but a passage — I move through versions of myself the way others move through rooms. But whoever can pass through everything comes together nowhere. Home isn't the form that lasts longest; it's the form I dare to sleep in.

extensions.name: The Ace
extensions.gift: Excellence with a grin: wins the contest and makes it look like play; the ace whose lightness is not the absence of discipline but its final form.
extensions.curse: The streak ending → the grin is load-bearing; identity soldered to effortlessness; would rather not try than be seen trying and failing.
extensions.levensles: Everything I do looks effortless — and that is trademark, hiding place and vanity all at once: I'd rather win where everyone can see — but applause for a mask doesn't warm the face beneath it. Nobody saw my greatest victory: working openly for something, falling short, and staying on my feet.

extensions.name: The Arbiter
extensions.gift: Impartial authority at system-scale: the verdict that binds because the structure behind it is sound; integrity enforced wall to wall.
extensions.curse: System-errors → draconian; punishment without context; the arbiter who serves the code so purely that the case disappears behind it.
extensions.levensles: The system I build to make everything just must also have room for what it cannot contain — a bow cannot always stay drawn. The strongest verdict I ever delivered was the one in which I bent the rule because otherwise the person would have broken.

extensions.name: The Whistleblower
extensions.gift: Objective law wielding disruption: blows corrupt systems open to reveal the truth; the one insider willing to detonate their own position for the record.
extensions.curse: Top-level hypocrisy → violent stress-spike; the detonation becomes the identity; keeps blowing open what a quieter hand could have healed.
extensions.levensles: Not every truth needs an explosion; sometimes the most powerful act is to stand quietly in it and refuse to join the lie. The hardest truth I ever spoke cost me everything, and I would do it again — but now I first look to see whether there is someone who can simply open the door.

extensions.name: The Inquisitor
extensions.gift: Truth-finding by interrogation: reads the flinch, asks the one question the lie cannot survive; corruption exposed not with a bomb but with a mirror.
extensions.curse: An answer that will not come → the questioning becomes the cruelty; suspects everyone, converts every conversation into an examination no one passes.
extensions.levensles: One good question demolishes more than a hundred reproaches. But the day I began to interrogate my loved ones like suspects, I understood: a gaze that can only see through can no longer look someone in the eye.

extensions.name: The Critic
extensions.gift: Quality-control at the level of first principles: finds the hidden fallacy, the structural rot, the hypocrisy in the argument itself; the standard everyone secretly wants to pass.
extensions.curse: Intellectual error left standing → obsession with what is wrong; cynical rumination; a mind so trained on flaws it can no longer see that something works.
extensions.levensles: Seeing what does not add up is half of my gift. The other half is building anyway, knowing it will be imperfect — otherwise I am not a guardian of quality but a gravedigger of every beginning.

extensions.name: The Appraiser
extensions.gift: Judgement with an eye: values what others overlook, prices the priceless honestly; the verdict that tells a maker not only what is wrong but what is RARE.
extensions.curse: Kitsch rewarded, mastery ignored → contempt; the appraisal turns to gatekeeping; forgets that taste is a lens, and starts wielding it as a law.
extensions.levensles: I can see the value of what everyone walks past — that is my eye. But the judgement I spent longest revising was about something that failed by every measure and still kept someone standing. Since then I first appraise what something carries, and only then what it is worth.

extensions.name: The Examiner
extensions.gift: Moral weighing in service of the new: the ethical gatekeeper who tests ideas without killing them; purity as a standard, hope as the reason for the standard.
extensions.curse: Stagnation or corruption of the pure → paralysing perfectionism; no candidate ever passes; the gate becomes a wall and the examiner its prisoner.
extensions.levensles: Purity is not a condition for starting; it is what remains when I move honestly. The strictest exam I ever set, I set for myself: letting something pass that was not yet finished, because it was true nonetheless.

extensions.name: The Auditor
extensions.gift: The audit as expedition: follows the money, the paper, the anomaly across any terrain; findings no one can dispute because every step is walked and logged.
extensions.curse: A trail that ends nowhere → cannot close the file; keeps travelling through ledgers long after the answer stopped mattering; verification as a way of never arriving.
extensions.levensles: I go over everything from a distance, and it all checks out. But checking out is not yet being sound — I only know that once I have been inside. The hardest verdict I can pass is: good enough. And then taking my hands off it.

extensions.name: The Avenger
extensions.gift: Justice with hands: does not file the wrong away but goes and ends it; protects the oppressed with a will that corruption learns to fear.
extensions.curse: Powerlessness → vigilantism; cruel means for right ends; the avenger who no longer tests the own verdict has become a weapon that thinks it is a court.
extensions.levensles: The more convinced I am, the harder I have to doubt. Justice that no longer asks itself questions ends up dealing the same blows as what it came to fight.

extensions.name: The Enforcer
extensions.gift: Enforcement by design: builds the mechanism that makes the wrong impossible rather than punished; consequence engineered into the system itself.
extensions.curse: A loophole found → the machinery tightens until it grinds the innocent too; enforcement so total that mercy has no interface left to enter through.
extensions.levensles: The best boundary is one no one has to guard — you build it so that the wrong jams all by itself. But a system without a back door also keeps the mistake captive. With me, one door stays ajar: the one for whoever truly did not know.

extensions.name: The Mediator
extensions.gift: Icy objectivity warmed by care: restores broken relationships by weighing both sides AND holding both; the verdict people can live with because both were seen.
extensions.curse: Emotional distance → suspends the objective truth to keep the peace; the mediation that heals the room and quietly buries the wrong.
extensions.levensles: The truth I soften to keep the peace is the same truth that slowly hollows out the relationship. The bravest form of care is honesty that hurts at the right moment — a peace that rests on a buried fact is a stay of execution.

extensions.name: The Reconciler
extensions.gift: Reconciliation through felt fairness: reads the hurt under both positions and speaks it aloud; the settlement that lands because both hearts heard themselves in it.
extensions.curse: A rift that resonance cannot bridge → takes the failure personally; keeps mending what wants to end; peace pursued past the point where the truth was the kinder outcome.
extensions.levensles: I can make two people who no longer hear each other both feel heard. But not every break asks for glue. Sometimes apart is the only verdict both hearts can fit into.

extensions.name: The Alchemist
extensions.gift: Visionary will embodied: rewrites the world's interface AND pushes the rewrite through resistance; paradigm-shifts delivered, not just designed.
extensions.curse: The immovable — death, another's will → grandiosity or breakdown at absolute loss of control; the alchemy that cannot accept lead that chooses to stay lead.
extensions.levensles: I can change almost anything — a situation, a mood, a life. Almost. The limit is not called failure; it is called a limit. The greatest change I ever went through was accepting that some things are allowed to stay what they are.

extensions.name: The Engineer
extensions.gift: Magic meets structure: reads the timeline's hidden variables and pours them into stable, prophetic systems; the blueprint that was right before its time and lasted past it.
extensions.curse: External chaos endangering the blueprint → forces reality without empathy; people become numbers in the equation; the design defended against its own users.
extensions.levensles: My plans are right — that is not the problem. A plan that reality is not allowed to correct is not a vision but a verdict. The variable I forgot the longest had a voice: the people who had to live inside it.

extensions.name: The Reckoner
extensions.gift: Transformation with a ledger: computes what every change will cost and who will pay it; power exercised with the receipts attached; the reckoning nobody can dispute.
extensions.curse: An unpayable debt discovered → the reckoner turns collector; mercy has no cell in the spreadsheet; accounts settled so precisely the relationship goes bankrupt.
extensions.levensles: I always know what something costs and who pays. But there are bills you should not collect. The most valuable sum of my life: a debt that was correct to the last penny — forgiven.

extensions.name: The Protagonist
extensions.gift: Reality bent by seizing the narrative: steps into the centre of the story and turns it; the protagonist whose audacity makes the world reorganise around them.
extensions.curse: A story that will not cast them → sabotages other leads; life as a plot that must centre them; allies reduced to supporting roles until the cast walks out.
extensions.levensles: The world takes shape around whoever dares to carry the story, so I carried it — everywhere, always. But a lead with no one to play opposite plays to an empty house. My best chapter began when I gave someone else the opening.

extensions.name: The Enchanter
extensions.gift: Bends reality with a spell and a laugh — and it works; transformation so charming that the world cooperates before it notices it changed.
extensions.curse: Until it doesn't; the situation they cannot conjure their way out of becomes the teacher — and the pupil arrives furious at the lesson.
extensions.levensles: With charm and timing I can get almost anything moving — and it works, until it doesn't. The situation I could not talk my way out of became my teacher. Charm opens every door except the one that only opens to honesty.

extensions.name: The Sorcerer
extensions.gift: Transformation through detachment: steps outside daily reality to grasp the deepest mechanism; returns with the one intervention that changes everything.
extensions.curse: Vague variables → loses body-contact; misunderstood, retreats into the tower; the cure discovered and never delivered because the surface felt beneath him.
extensions.levensles: I go deeper than most people want to — to the root, the mechanism, the real cause. But what I find there only counts once it reaches the surface. Connection is the hardest part of every descent.

extensions.name: The Performer
extensions.gift: The change staged: transforms a room, an audience, a market by performance — the demonstration so compelling that seeing it IS being changed by it.
extensions.curse: Applause as the metric → performs past the truth; the act polished until it replaces the work; achievement curated instead of earned.
extensions.levensles: I can make a room believe anything is possible — and attention began to feel like proof. But applause is an echo. I learned the most from the time it went wrong while the work behind it was sound; since then I have lived for my purpose.

extensions.name: The Catalyst
extensions.gift: Transformation fed by purity: burns the old world optimistically to ash and forges better; the catalyst whose faith in the new lowers everyone's activation-energy.
extensions.curse: Noble creations misused → the high stress-tolerance snaps; the fire that made the change turns on the maker's faith; hope's chemistry poisoned by its first betrayal.
extensions.levensles: Wherever I walk in, a movement starts — that is what faith does to a room. But a catalyst does not use itself up. The day I could start the process without burning out, my hope finally felt sustainable.

extensions.name: The Trailblazer
extensions.gift: Transformation as trailbreaking: opens routes through what everyone called impassable — industries, ideas, wildernesses; behind them, roads exist where walls were.
extensions.curse: An opened trail institutionalised → contempt for the settlers; breaks new ground compulsively, honours nothing built on the old ground, including their own.
extensions.levensles: Behind me lie roads where walls once stood. But a breakthrough only counts when someone who is not me can get through it. The road that succeeded is the one that filled with traffic — and that I did not look down on.

extensions.name: The Shaman
extensions.gift: Transformation through the heart: performs alchemy on relationships, forging grief and hate into real connection and love; the healer of what happens BETWEEN people.
extensions.curse: Emotional rejection → deep insecurity; risks steering the other; charm that manages a heart is manipulation wearing ceremony.
extensions.levensles: I sense exactly where it sits in someone — and what I sense, I can move. But moving someone by way of their pain is not healing, not even with the best intentions; it is walking in without knocking. The real magic is making the space in which someone does the reforging themselves — while all I do is guard the fire.

extensions.name: The Redeemer
extensions.gift: Transformation FOR someone: descends into another's ruin and forges the way out; redemption engineered — the addict, the lost, the condemned, carried through the fire to the far side.
extensions.curse: A soul that will not be saved → cannot release; redeems past consent; the redeemer whose worth depends on the drowning, and who therefore — quietly — needs the flood.
extensions.levensles: I have carried people through their darkest stretch — and that is my honour. But a rescue nobody asked for is a second prison. The hardest thing was letting go of someone who did not yet want to be saved — and holding the door open without pulling on it.
