extensions.name: The Legend
extensions.gift: Pure heroic will at its zenith: the performance that becomes a story others live by; resilience so complete it transforms what people believe is possible.
extensions.curse: The jug goes to the well until it breaks — and they WERE the jug; the legend maintained after the body filed its objection; applause mistaken for fuel.
extensions.levensles: Everyone tells the same story about me: that one just keeps going. I fed that story until it had me in its grip — push on long enough and you become the villain of your own story.

extensions.name: The Conqueror
extensions.gift: Conquest that holds: wins the ground AND organises it; force converted into standing order; the campaign whose ending is a functioning peace.
extensions.curse: A realm at rest → restlessness; peace read as decay; the conqueror who must keep finding walls because he only knows himself mid-siege.
extensions.levensles: Winning is the easy part; every wall falls to enough will. But what I won only became mine when I stayed. The hardest victory was coping with the very peace I had fought for.

extensions.name: The Templar
extensions.gift: Force under vows: fights only for what has been weighed and found just; the warrior whose restraint is as feared as his blade; power that keeps its oath.
extensions.curse: The code betrayed by its own church → crisis; either crusades harder to silence the doubt or breaks entirely; righteousness calcified into the very thing the vow opposed.
extensions.levensles: I bound my strength to a code — and a code does not doubt. Until I saw who my hardness landed on: not on evil, but on suffering. The oath belongs to justice. A templar without a temple can still stand straight.

extensions.name: The Raider
extensions.gift: Force unbound: strikes where slow armies cannot; takes what fortified injustice hoarded; the raid as surgery on a rotten order.
extensions.curse: No worthy target → the raiding becomes the point; plunder without a cause; strength that, unemployed by meaning, starts billing the innocent.
extensions.levensles: I strike where others are too slow — fast, hard, past every flag. But a blow without a reason is violence with a tall story. The plunder I carried the longest was a moral question. Strength without a commander must become one itself — a good one.

extensions.name: The Agent
extensions.gift: The contest won in shadow: infiltrates, reads, misdirects; the agent whose greatest victories are the battles that never had to happen.
extensions.curse: No handler, no mission → identity dissolves into covers; the spy who has been everyone so long that 'me' is the one legend never built.
extensions.levensles: I have won fights that never got any attention — by being who I had to be, where I had to be. But wear every mask perfectly and you lose the face beneath. The most dangerous mission of my life was the return: becoming someone who needs no cover to exist.

extensions.name: The Strategist
extensions.gift: Execution fed by deep pattern: foresees the entire campaign, wins before the first move; force multiplied by comprehension.
extensions.curse: Worst-case projection → paralysis by the modelled catastrophe; and the one cost every model omitted — the strategist himself, spent as a pawn.
extensions.levensles: I calculate everything three moves ahead — the conversation, the choice, the group. One item I kept forgetting: myself. Since then every plan of mine has one fixed rule — the maker has to survive it.

extensions.name: The Duelist
extensions.gift: Combat as craft: the duel fought beautifully — precision, style, honour; wins in a way that even the defeated call masterful.
extensions.curse: An ugly, necessary fight → refuses it; aesthetics over outcome; the duelist who would rather lose exquisitely than win gracelessly, and calls it principle.
extensions.levensles: I fight for the form, not the result — and that freedom is real. But not caring about the result also became my way of never having to want anything. Once, I truly wanted something — and that was more frightening than any fight.

extensions.name: The Astronaut
extensions.gift: The impossible attempted with discipline: trains for years to cross what no one crossed; heroism aimed at the frontier itself rather than an enemy.
extensions.curse: No launch window → the drive corrodes inward; earth feels like defeat; a life calibrated for the exceptional that cannot metabolise an ordinary Tuesday.
extensions.levensles: I train for years for moments that may never come — and straight after, I look for the next mountain. Peaking I can do; coming back I cannot. Learning that an ordinary Tuesday is not a defeat was harder than any summit.

extensions.name: The Crusader
extensions.gift: Will in service of a shining cause: fights for the good with total conviction; the crusade that moves mountains because its soldier genuinely believes.
extensions.curse: The cause revealed impure → cannot afford to see it; doubles down; the crusader who burns the village to save the story he tells about himself.
extensions.levensles: I committed myself fully to something because I believed in it — and when the belief began to waver, I went harder. Hardening is not always an answer to doubt. The bravest day was the day I stopped halfway and asked: is this still right?

extensions.name: The Protector
extensions.gift: Combat-strength for compassion: the human shield; catches every blow for the vulnerable and endures impossible hardship to keep others whole.
extensions.curse: Other's suffering unpreventable → the shield that never asks for help breaks first; protection given as a debt no one may ever repay.
extensions.levensles: I take the blows for the people I love — it is not a choice, it is reflex. But anyone who never asks for help breaks first. The bravest protection I ever gave was admitting I needed protection myself.

extensions.name: The Chevalier
extensions.gift: Chivalric devotion: strength placed wholly at the service of one beloved — the vow, the favour, the standing-between; love expressed as guarding presence.
extensions.curse: The beloved not needing rescue → purposeless; invents dragons; the knight who loves the rescuing more than the person, and calls the pedestal devotion.
extensions.levensles: I dedicated my strength to one person and called it love. But protecting someone on a pedestal is not the same as knowing them. The most loving thing I ever did was to meet their eyes instead of bowing.

extensions.name: The Navigator
extensions.gift: Mapping with a compass of trust: explores not to escape but to chart; brings back objective new truths AND the faith that the crossing is worth it.
extensions.curse: Stagnation → intolerable; calculates escape-variants from any stillness; the map grows while the home-coordinate stays forever blank.
extensions.levensles: The map I draw along the way is brilliant — but a map is not a home. The hardest terrain I ever entered was the place where I decided to stay.

extensions.name: The Networker
extensions.gift: Exploration through people, organised: builds the network as infrastructure — introductions, alliances, routes between worlds; the connector whose map is made of names.
extensions.curse: Social exclusion or a static circle → the engine stalls; collects contacts past the point of contact; a friend to all, anchored to none.
extensions.levensles: I discover the world through people — every connection is a new route. But a network without anchors is a web blowing in the wind. Be a friend to all and you soon become your own enemy. The most valuable connection I ever made was with my own essence.

extensions.name: The Surveyor
extensions.gift: Exploration with a measuring line: surveys the unknown precisely — what is here, what it is worth, where the boundary honestly runs; the vanguard whose reports hold up.
extensions.curse: Disputed ground → rigid; the surveyor who trusts the instrument over the inhabitant; borders drawn correct and cruel.
extensions.levensles: I survey everything from a distance: what it is worth, where the boundary lies, what is amiss. But perfecting the line became my way of never crossing it. The land I have come to know best is the land I finally walked into.

extensions.name: The Innovator
extensions.gift: Restless invention with teeth: does not just see the next thing but breaks the current thing open to build it; innovation as productive rebellion.
extensions.curse: Abandonment of the made → a trail of brilliant orphans; the world lacks not inventions but people who stay with their inventions past the honeymoon.
extensions.levensles: I was always three versions ahead — innovating came naturally, asking whether it was needed did not. Most of what I built solved a problem nobody had. My best work began with the question I skipped the longest: who is this for?

extensions.name: The Scout
extensions.gift: The scout who reads the trick of the land: sees the ambush, the shortcut, the tell in the terrain; travels light, arrives first, laughs at the map's mistakes.
extensions.curse: Loss of the own discipline-anchor → drifts; cleverness without a mission scouts in circles; the first to arrive everywhere and commit nowhere.
extensions.levensles: I scout with the discipline of a soldier and the eyes of a columnist — I see what the map keeps quiet. But the wildest discovery is not the next territory. It is the moment I look inward and ask: where do I place my attention — and for whom?

extensions.name: The Philosopher
extensions.gift: The philosophy of the road: travels to understand, not to collect; every border crossed becomes a concept tested; wisdom with dust on its boots.
extensions.curse: Disembodiment → theory detached from ground; the philosopher who has been everywhere and touched nothing; insight that never lands because it never stays.
extensions.levensles: The theory I seek beyond the horizon — it is there. But matter only takes shape when I get my hands dirty. Knowledge that only travels in my head arrives nowhere. I found my deepest insight not at the summit, but in the village down in the valley.

extensions.name: The Bard
extensions.gift: The road turned into song: gathers the world's stories and carries them between places; the bard whose travel IS the archive, whose telling makes strangers kin.
extensions.curse: No audience, no hearth → the songs sour; performs the journey instead of living it; a life narrated so continuously it was never quite attended.
extensions.levensles: I gather the stories and carry them on — that is my craft and my breath. But there is one story you cannot tell on the road: your own. That story asks for a fire, a circle, and the courage to stay seated until it is done.

extensions.name: The Sailor
extensions.gift: Proven resilience: survives everything — the storm, the doldrums, the loss of the cargo; endurance so deep it has become a kind of navigation.
extensions.curse: Endless survival → the question is not whether they make it but whether they ever arrive somewhere that does not require surviving; rest read as surrender.
extensions.levensles: I survive everything — that has been proven. The question is whether I ever arrive somewhere I do not have to survive. Rest is the harbour I avoided the longest and needed the most.

extensions.name: The Nomad
extensions.gift: Mastery of the unrooted life: makes a home of movement itself; resources conjured anywhere, belonging carried inside; free because nothing external is load-bearing.
extensions.curse: An offered root → panic dressed as principle; transforms every 'stay' into a reason to go; the nomad whose freedom is a wall with wheels.
extensions.levensles: Home is where I am — my whole existence fits in what I can carry, and that is freedom. Until someone asked whether I wanted to stay, and my freedom turned out to be a wall with wheels. Putting down roots is not a betrayal of the journey. It is the journey that begins when I say no to more.

extensions.name: The Stargazer
extensions.gift: Wonder as connection: explores upward and outward and takes someone's hand while doing it; the night sky, the far coast, the unknown — offered as a shared astonishment.
extensions.curse: A companion who stops looking up → drifts to the next pair of eyes; loves the wondering-together more than the together; horizons collected, harbours declined.
extensions.levensles: I have shown the stars to more people than I can count — sharing wonder is my way of loving. But the sky comes back every night, and people do not. The most beautiful night was not the clearest; it was the night my gaze stayed beside me.

extensions.name: The Pathfinder
extensions.gift: Trailfinding as service: goes ahead not for the glory of first but to make the way passable for those who follow; marks the path, carries the weak across.
extensions.curse: No one following → purposelessness; or refuses to let the followers ever lead; the pathfinder who needs the lost more than the lost need the path.
extensions.levensles: I light the path so that others can follow safely — every marker is for someone I will never see. But the day someone overtook me, I had to choose between my role and my purpose. The path has succeeded when it no longer needs me.

extensions.name: The Demiurge
extensions.gift: The peak of the creative axis: designs entire subjective universes and new paradigms of existence; worlds so coherent people move in and live by their physics.
extensions.curse: Reality's limits → refusal to compromise with the physical world; God-complex on setback; and the inhabitants of the made world treated as characters, not people.
extensions.levensles: The worlds I dream up are bigger than reality — and the people in them are not characters. The moment I forget that, my world is a stage set. The best worlds I have built have roads.

extensions.name: The Architect
extensions.gift: Creative flow captured in brilliant structures: designs systems and buildings both beautiful AND usable; form that serves living as faithfully as it serves the eye.
extensions.curse: People disobeying the perfect blueprint → merciless; the aesthetic defended against its inhabitants; architecture sliding into tyranny one 'don't touch' at a time.
extensions.levensles: What I design is brilliant and beautiful — and a cage if no one is allowed to breathe in it. The difference between form and coercion is whether the inhabitant may complete the design. My best work was only finished once people moved in — and changed it.

extensions.name: The Editor
extensions.gift: The merciful knife: sees what a work wants to be and cuts away everything else; the editor whose deletions are a form of faith in the maker.
extensions.curse: The cut turned on everything → nothing survives revision; perfection as a paper-shredder; edits the life as ruthlessly as the page until neither has a draft left standing.
extensions.levensles: I cut away what is superfluous, and what remains is what it was about. But the red pencil I found hardest to put down hung over my own life. Some sentences are good enough because they were lived. Full stop.

extensions.name: The Troubadour
extensions.gift: Art as courtship of the world: sings feeling directly to its subject; the troubadour whose work closes the distance between hearts in real time, in the room.
extensions.curse: The applause standing in for the beloved → serenades everyone, reaches no one; performs longing so beautifully the actual longing never gets a turn to speak plainly.
extensions.levensles: I can make a feeling straight for someone — more beautiful than it can be said. But there is one sentence that mustn't just be beautiful, but true as well: the bare truth of what I feel. The best translation I ever made was ordinary.

extensions.name: The Storyteller
extensions.gift: Creation for connection: translates raw lonely emotion into stories that heal the group; the teller whose tales are how the community remembers it is one.
extensions.curse: Group disharmony → avoids the hard artistic truth to keep the peace and the audience; the story sweetened until it no longer nourishes.
extensions.levensles: I give shape to what we go through — grief, happiness, history — so that it can be carried. But whatever becomes a story straight away loses its rawness; in the end I remembered only my versions. The lesson lay in what I had forgotten: how something feels before it can be told.

extensions.name: The Oracle
extensions.gift: Truth delivered in symbol: speaks what is coming in images the present can hold; the oracle whose riddles are mercy — the future dosed so it can be received.
extensions.curse: Being believed too literally or not at all → speaks ever more obliquely; hides behind ambiguity; the oracle who was never once caught being plainly wrong because never once plainly anything.
extensions.levensles: I see what is coming and give it an image — and then it comes. For a long time I thought I was predicting, but I was building: whoever pronounces a future over someone sets them on the road towards it. My words are not a window but a door. Since then I speak about people as though it's coming true — because it is.

extensions.name: The Provocateur
extensions.gift: Creation as detonation: makes the work the polite world cannot un-see; the provocateur whose images do in one glance what a hundred essays argued.
extensions.curse: Shock as the only register → provokes past the point; the detonation without the payload; scandal collected while the message starves.
extensions.levensles: I make what decency cannot un-see. But an explosion without a payload is just noise. What I'm proudest of left no one angry — it left people silent. A far more dangerous beginning.

extensions.name: The Visionary
extensions.gift: Creation tied to discovery: looks decades ahead, predicts the coming shape, illuminates the future so vividly others start building toward it early.
extensions.curse: Analysis-paralysis in the now → heavy stress when the present demands presence; the visionary who lives at a coordinate no calendar can reach.
extensions.levensles: I see what will be standing in ten years — and miss what is standing right under my nose. The future needs me, but the present needs me more urgently: that's where my people live, my body, my life. A vision without today is an address without a house.

extensions.name: The Source
extensions.gift: Makes from pure clarity: the work arrives rather than being built — no irony, no calculation between eye and hand; a purity training cannot manufacture. The world calls it talent; talent was never what it was.
extensions.curse: The pure proven ordinary — the flow claimed as property, performed as skill → the channel silts; forms forced where they once arrived; the source left performing its own memory.
extensions.levensles: What I make flows of its own accord — I pass on what I see, unfiltered. The world called it talent and asked for more; as soon as I tried to own it, the spring silted up. The day I stopped wanting to make, the water came back. I am not the maker — I am the medium.

extensions.name: The Craftsman
extensions.gift: Craft as transformation: knows the material's secret grain and works WITH it; the craftsman whose objects hold because he understood what the material itself wanted to become.
extensions.curse: Mass-production and shortcuts everywhere → bitterness; the standard raised into a priesthood; perfect chairs made for a world dismissed as unworthy to sit.
extensions.levensles: You don't force material — you ask what it wants to become and work with it. The same goes for people, I learned late. And for myself, later still. My masterpiece is not a thing; it is the patience with which I learned to follow my own grain.

extensions.name: The Forgemaster
extensions.gift: Creation meets iron will: actively re-forges the world; design driven straight through material resistance; the smith who makes the tools history is then made with.
extensions.curse: Innovation-block → aggressive emotion-suppression, extreme tunnel-vision; sacrifices self and love to the forge; the maker fed piece by piece into his own machine.
extensions.levensles: I make with a willpower most people don't understand — and what I build keeps running even while I am being ground up in it. The difference between a masterpiece and a sacrifice is whether the maker survives it. My fire goes out every evening. That is exactly why it has burned for so long.

extensions.name: The Healer
extensions.gift: Service fused with deep intimacy: heals not at arm's length but skin-close; the safe haven where being truly seen is itself the medicine.
extensions.curse: Emotional disharmony → identity rests on the healing; when the patient recovers or resists, the healer's ground vanishes; care shades into codependent keeping.
extensions.levensles: The wound I heal in someone else remains theirs. My bravest form of care is letting the sun rise — and leaving the rising to the sun. My own healing begins where someone no longer needs me.

extensions.name: The Patriarch / Matriarch
extensions.gift: Compassion as an organised force: builds the household, the institution, the lineage that protects at scale; providence with a spine of governance.
extensions.curse: Anarchy or ingratitude → smothering; provision becomes leverage; the family held so safely no one in it is allowed to grow up.
extensions.levensles: I carry everything for those who live under my roof — and I built that roof myself. But a house no one is ever allowed to leave is a beautiful cage. The heaviest thing I ever gave was not care, not money, not a roof. It was permission to leave.

extensions.name: The Defender
extensions.gift: Protection with a verdict in its hand: defends the vulnerable by naming the wrong out loud; care that testifies, files, wins.
extensions.curse: A case lost → carries the client's fate as a personal failure; or defends so fiercely that the protected person's own voice never gets heard in court.
extensions.levensles: Speaking on someone's behalf is not defending. Defending is fighting for the space in which someone can speak for themselves. My best plea ended in silence — mine — while the one I was protecting finally took the floor.

extensions.name: The Cultivator
extensions.gift: Care that knows when not to intervene: holds a hand open instead of forcing the healing; grows people the way a gardener grows — conditions, not commands.
extensions.curse: Watching a destructive pattern repeat → the urge to break it for them; when restrained too long, either explodes into rescue or hardens into detachment.
extensions.levensles: Not everyone wants to heal my way. Sometimes the most powerful form of care is not breaking someone's pattern, but holding a hand open until they reach for it themselves. That patience is the heaviest thing I lift — and the only thing I have ever really seen work.

extensions.name: The Empath
extensions.gift: The emotional radar in service of care: feels the room's unspoken weather, reaches the person everyone else missed; comfort delivered before the tears.
extensions.curse: Absorbing what is read → carries every room home; boundaries dissolve into the other's state; the empath drowning in signal that was never theirs to hold.
extensions.levensles: I feel what hangs in a room before anyone says it — and for a long time I thought feeling also meant carrying. But a radar is not a storeroom. 'I feel your pain' connects; 'I take your pain' drowns us both.

extensions.name: The Therapist
extensions.gift: Care from psychological insight: sees the mechanism under the suffering; a self-replenishing source because understanding does not burn out the way absorbing does.
extensions.curse: Over-analysis → not all pain has a findable cause; the search for the why becomes a way of not sitting with the what; the patient explained, not accompanied.
extensions.levensles: Not all pain has a cause I can find. Real healing begins where I stop searching for the why and start carrying what is. Insight is my instrument; closeness is the medicine.

extensions.name: The Restorer
extensions.gift: Restoration as an art: mends what is damaged — objects, houses, people — with such attention that the repair becomes part of the beauty; kintsugi as a way of caring.
extensions.curse: The unrestorable → cannot accept that some things stay broken; keeps mending past consent; or grieves every crack as a personal failing of care.
extensions.levensles: True restoration is acknowledging the break and pouring gold into it. The people I have seen rise most beautifully were not the unbroken ones — they were the ones who dared to show their cracks because someone had touched them with reverence.

extensions.name: The Pilgrim
extensions.gift: Care in motion: accompanies another's journey step for step — the companion on the pilgrimage who carries the pack when the road gets steep.
extensions.curse: The journey's end → does not know how to stop walking beside; either finds a new pilgrim immediately or stands lost at the destination that was never theirs.
extensions.levensles: I guide others towards a freedom I sometimes do not allow myself. The question is not whether they are ready to let go — but whether I am ready to no longer be needed. The most beautiful moment of every journey is when the other walks on ahead and no longer looks back.

extensions.name: The Devotee
extensions.gift: Unconditional belief as care: sees the good in a person before they can see it themselves, and tends it faithfully until it takes root.
extensions.curse: The believed-in person failing → the faith doubles instead of adjusting; devotion to the potential blinds to the actual; loyal to who someone could be, absent from who they are.
extensions.levensles: I believe in people before they believe in themselves — and that belief has turned lives around. But devotion to who someone could be must never go deaf to who someone actually is. The deepest loyalty is serving the potential without abandoning the present.

extensions.name: The Guardian
extensions.gift: Vigilant protection: stands the watch no one sees, absorbs what would have reached the vulnerable; safety produced nightly by someone who never mentions it.
extensions.curse: Never off duty → who never takes off the armour forgets how the sun feels; the watch becomes the identity; protects everyone from everything except their own absence.
extensions.levensles: The shield I raise for others weighs more than I will ever admit. Whoever never takes off their armour forgets how the sun feels on their skin. The watch I found hardest to keep was over myself — the night I let someone else keep watch and the wall still stood.

extensions.name: The Warden
extensions.gift: Guardianship by design: does not fight the threat at the door but builds the door; wards, protocols, provisions — safety engineered so completely it looks like luck.
extensions.curse: Control mistaken for care → the ward becomes a cell; keeps what it protects; the warden who cannot tell anymore whether the locks face outward or inward.
extensions.levensles: I provide safety the way others build walls — invisible, watertight, everywhere. Until I saw that my locks had started pointing inward. The safest place I ever built had a key — and it hung on the inside.

Judge.gift: Binnen dit model geassocieerd met ongeëvenaarde integriteit: de sterke CEN-FPN netwerkkoppeling maakt vlijmscherpe morele weging en objectieve audits mogelijk. Serotonerge stabiliteit stelt hen in staat beslissingen vrij van bias te nemen.
Judge.curse: Extreme rigiditeit. Actieve onderdrukking van limbische (emotionele) input leidt tot draconische oordelen en een kil gebrek aan genade.

Lover.gift: DMN-Limbische koppeling resulteert in onbegrensde empathie. Oxytocine-cascades maken diepe emotionele resonantie en versmelting mogelijk.
Lover.curse: Codependentie en identiteitsverlies. Om de BST-stress van verlating te bezweren, geven ze hun eigen 'ik' op en storten hun grenzen in.

Caregiver.gift: Binnen dit model geassocieerd met helende capaciteit: de limbische focus en oxytocine-paden maken ongeëvenaarde zorg en het feilloos scannen van behoeften mogelijk.
Caregiver.curse: Martelaarschap. Chronische overbelasting van het systeem en het negeren van de eigen behoeften leidt tot een stille, geïnternaliseerde wrok en uiteindelijke burn-out.

Innocent.gift: Een ongeëvenaarde koppeling tussen het DMN en beloningscircuits voedt een absoluut, hoopvol moraal kompas en diep vertrouwen in de goede afloop.
Innocent.curse: Naïviteit en de slachtofferrol. Het negeren van reële dreigingen leidt tot totale passiviteit wanneer ze geconfronteerd worden met corruptie.

Explorer.gift: Uitzonderlijk hoge Openness. Salience Network hyper-activatie gekoppeld aan dopamine-gedreven "novelty seeking" stelt hen in staat ongebaande paden te navigeren.
Explorer.curse: Doelloos dwalen en sociale isolatie. De biologische drang om verbindingen te verbreken zodra de nieuwheid eraf is, voorkomt elke vorm van diepte of toewijding.

Outlaw.gift: Absolute authenticiteit. Dopamine-beloningscircuits zijn gekoppeld aan het benoemen van hypocrisie en het doorbreken van rigide, stagnerende kaders.
Outlaw.curse: Destructief cynisme. Het vermogen om op te bouwen wordt vernietigd door de verslaving aan de chaos. Ze laten uitsluitend as achter.

Trickster.gift: Geniaal, fluïde perspectief. Het Salience Network is gekoppeld aan snelle, onorthodoxe associaties, waardoor ze ego's en hiërarchieën feilloos kunnen doorprikken.
Trickster.curse: Wreedheid en de "sad clown" paradox. Het dwangmatige vermijden van pijn zorgt voor toxisch nihilisme waarbij alles een grap is en ware verbinding sterft.

Sage.gift: Superieure patroonherkenning. De prefrontale focus is gekoppeld aan onmetelijke onthechting, waardoor ze feilloos door de ruis van paniek heen snijden.
Sage.curse: Emotionele kilte en dogmatisme. Ze sluiten de buitenwereld volledig buiten en blijven veilig opgesloten in een steriele ivoren toren.

Artist.gift: Visionaire alchemie en uitzonderlijk hoge Openness. Ze kunnen abstract, onbewust materiaal omvormen tot universeel resonerende esthetiek.
Artist.curse: Escapisme en verlammend perfectionisme. Het onvermogen om om te gaan met de harde realiteit leidt tot totale dissociatie en onbruikbare, introverte wanen.

Magician.gift: Het vermogen om de interface van de wereld te veranderen. DMN-PFC koppeling wordt gecombineerd met wilskracht om onzichtbare dynamieken en paradigma's te verschuiven.
Magician.curse: Een arrogant God-complex. De compulsieve drang om alles te moeten transformeren sluit elke vorm van rust of onvoorwaardelijke acceptatie uit.

Hero.gift: Uitzonderlijke executiekracht en veerkracht onder druk. De capaciteit om testosteron en dopamine te binden aan het overwinnen van weerstand.
Hero.curse: Terminale arrogantie. Door hun eigen pantser sluiten ze af voor empathie en zien ze het vragen om hulp (zwakte) als een fatale fout.

Ruler.gift: Binnen dit model geassocieerd met absolute soevereiniteit: CEN-dominantie en serotonine-stabiliteit sturen ordelijk bestuur, welvaart en veilige architectuur aan.
Ruler.curse: Tirannie en verlammende controle. Om chaos uit te sluiten, bevriezen ze het systeem, wat leidt tot een meedogenloze onderdrukking van alle vrijheid of innovatie.
